summary_en: 923,600 shares to be cancelled (12.15% of shares outstanding before cancellation). Post-cancellation shares outstanding: 6,676,400. Effective date 2026-10-13. Conditional on approval of stock consolidation (ratio and effective date 2026-10-14) at shareholders' meeting 2026-09-10.
title_en: Notice Regarding Cancellation of Treasury Shares
translation_en_brief: On 6 August 2026, Nissin Shoji's board of directors resolved to cancel 923,600 treasury shares held by the company, representing 12.15% of shares outstanding prior to cancellation. The cancellation is scheduled to take effect on 13 October 2026, conditional upon shareholders approving a concurrent stock consolidation at an extraordinary shareholders' meeting on 10 September 2026 (with the consolidation effective 14 October 2026). Following cancellation, the company's shares outstanding will be 6,676,400. The shares to be cancelled represent all treasury shares held as of the shareholders' meeting record date of 2 July 2026.
